node: Sulphur and sulphuric-acid feedstock for copper SX-EW and nickel HPAL
summary: Expanded the universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. The reference lane uses Freeport-McMoRan as a large copper/SX-EW and smelter-acid context anchor. The underfollowed lane prioritizes US-listed or US-OTC listed small/mid-cap assets one or two steps away from the obvious copper/nickel price trade: Chemtrade as a North American sulphuric-acid supplier, Nexa as a Latin American zinc smelter with sulphuric-acid byproduct/export logistics, Taseko as an SX-EW copper producer whose Florence ramp makes reagent access a direct operational variable. Several claims remain hypotheses because current public evidence supports business exposure but not yet margin capture from the 2026 sulphur/acid shock.
